topic: Shirahoshi's crying is the summon that calls the Sea Kings, so Hody's taunt backfires
title: Shirahoshi's Crying Is The Weapon Fans Laughed At
description: Shirahoshi gets labeled a crybaby, but her fear is what calls the Sea Kings, and Hody's taunt in episode 552 backfires because of it. Here's my read on why the tears are the weapon. Do you think it was planned from the start?
comment: Is Shirahoshi's crying a weapon Oda planned from the start, or a crutch the story leans on when Luffy needs a fight?

lines.text: Shirahoshi's crying is the weapon, and most fans laughed at it.

shot.fallback: close up of a crying mermaid princess, anime style

lines.text: In episode 545, a World Noble threatens her mother, and her panic calls Sea Kings up.

shot.fallback: mermaid queen threatened in a palace hall, anime style

lines.text: The monsters come because she's terrified, not because she chose them.

shot.fallback: sea monsters rising behind a frightened mermaid princess, anime style

lines.text: Later, Hody taunts her for wishing for peace.

shot.fallback: villain sneering at a mermaid princess, anime style

lines.text: She answers through tears, saying she knew the truth all along.

shot.fallback: defiant mermaid princess facing a villain, anime style

lines.text: Hody and Neptune are stunned, and her crying carries the answer.

shot.fallback: stunned villain and king staring at a mermaid princess, anime style

lines.text: Here's my read: he expected silence, and got the truth instead.

shot.fallback: angry villain facing a crying mermaid, anime style

lines.text: Episode 16 shows her cry reflected in Hody's blade as it descends.

shot.fallback: blade reflecting a crying face, anime style

lines.text: Then Luffy arrives with a full-force kick.

shot.fallback: straw hat pirate delivering a powerful kick, anime style

lines.text: The Sea King wiki says only a few people can hear the Sea Kings.

shot.fallback: pirate listening to sea monsters in the ocean, anime style

lines.text: Luffy is one of them, and that's no accident.

shot.fallback: pirate and mermaid princess smiling together, anime style

lines.text: Her fear calls a sea that could plunge the world beneath the waves.

shot.fallback: huge sea monster over an island in a storm, anime style

lines.text: That's why the World Government dreads her.

shot.fallback: navy officers watching a mermaid princess warily, anime style

lines.text: The crybaby label is the trap, and the cry is the weapon.

shot.fallback: crying mermaid princess with sea monsters behind her, anime style

self_check.hook: Line 1 names Shirahoshi and her crying as the weapon, so the opening frame is her close-up.
self_check.loop: The last line ends on the crybaby trap and the cry as weapon, which leads straight back into line 1.
